evidence.fact: Strike documents strike-1 as an EU-hosted typed-decision API (OVH Gravelines) answering yes/no, choice and score questions with probabilities; no weights are published. The vendor describes it as a fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (not verifiable from outside) and as beta.

strike-1.note: Hosted API measured on the 27 Oct 2026 draw; the stated base is the vendor's, no architecture or parameter count is inferred.
